description: This file defines the PathAliasListBuilder class in Drupal, responsible for building and rendering a list of path alias entities, including filtering, sorting, and displaying alias information with support for multilingual sites.

classes.name: PathAliasListBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and displays a list of path alias entities, with filtering, sorting, and multilingual support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list builder with dependencies such as request, form builder, language manager, and alias manager.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of PathAliasListBuilder with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves entity IDs based on search query and applies sorting and pagination.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Builds the render array for the list, including a filter form and empty message.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the table header for the list, including alias, path, and optionally language columns.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for each path alias entity, including links to alias and system path, and highlights old aliases.
